## Books

- [Treating alcohol dependence: A coping skills training guide, 2nd ed.](https://psycnet.apa.org/record/2002-18180-000)
  - Monti, P. M., Kadden, R. M., Rohsenow, D. J., Cooney, N. L., & Abrams, D. B. (2002).
  - Guilford Press, but hard to find now.
- [Brief Intervention for Adolescent Alcohol and Substance Abuse](https://www.guilford.com/books/Brief-Interventions-for-Adolescent-Alcohol-and-Substance-Abuse/Monti-Colby-Tevyaw/9781462535002)
  - Edited by Peter M. Monti, Suzanne M. Colby, and Tracy O'Leary Tevyaw
- [Harm Reduction, 2nd Edition](https://www.guilford.com/books/Harm-Reduction/Marlatt-Larimer-Witkiewitz/9781462502561)
  - Edited by G. Alan Marlatt, Mary E. Larimer, and Katie Witkiewitz
- [Relapse Prevention, 2nd Edition](https://www.guilford.com/books/Relapse-Prevention/Marlatt-Donovan/9781593856410)
  - Edited by G. Alan Marlatt and Dennis M. Donovan
- [Contingency Management in Substance Abuse Treatment](https://www.guilford.com/books/Contingency-Management-in-Substance-Abuse-Treatment/Higgins-Silverman-Heil/9781593855710)
  - Edited by Stephen T. Higgins, Kenneth Silverman, and Sarah H. Heil
- [Psychological Theories of Drinking and Alcoholism](https://www.guilford.com/books/Psychological-Theories-of-Drinking-and-Alcoholism/Leonard-Blane/9781572304109)
  - Edited by Kenneth E. Leonard and Howard Thomas Blane
- [Treating Alcohol and Drug Problems in Psychotherapy Practice, 2nd Edition](https://www.guilford.com/books/Treating-Alcohol-and-Drug-Problems-in-Psychotherapy-Practice/Washton-Zweben/9781462550869)
  - Arnold M. Washton and Joan E. Zweben
- [Mindfulness-Based Relapse Prevention for Addictive Behaviors](https://www.guilford.com/books/Mindfulness-Based-Relapse-Prevention-for-Addictive-Behaviors/Bowen-Chawla-Grow-Marlatt/9781462545315)
  - Sarah Bowen, Neha Chawla, Joel Grow, and G. Alan Marlatt
- [DBT Skills Training Manual](https://www.guilford.com/books/DBT-Skills-Training-Manual/Marsha-Linehan/9781462556359)
  - Marsha M. Linehan
- [Clinical Handbook of Adolescent Addiction](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/book/10.1002/9781118340851)
  - Editor(s):Richard Rosner
- [Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy of Addictive Disorders](https://www.guilford.com/books/Cognitive-Behavioral-Therapy-of-Addictive-Disorders/Liese-Beck/9781462548842)
  - Bruce S. Liese and Aaron T. Beck
- [Substance Abuse Treatment and the Stages of Change, 2nd Edition](https://www.guilford.com/books/Substance-Abuse-Treatment-and-the-Stages-of-Change/Connors-DiClemente-Velasquez-Donovan/9781462524983)
  - Gerard J. Connors, Carlo C. DiClemente, Mary Marden Velasquez, and Dennis M. Donovan
- [Treating Addiction, 2nd Edition](https://www.guilford.com/books/Treating-Addiction/Miller-Forcehimes-Zweben/9781462540440)
